global_rules: Arithmetic is distinct from drug/product/concentration/material/temperature stability evidence.
A supported diluent is not a complete Y-site compatibility matrix. Do not label unlisted combinations proven incompatible.
Immediate use after preparation is not a zero-duration infusion order; connected-system hang time requires its own basis.
Do not apply a common24h tubing rule to all17 drugs. Pharmacy/local conditions and manufacturer/device limits remain specific.
Commercial examples or EU/Spanish authorization do not demonstrate Portugal/Azores local stock.
Clinical guidelines determine syndrome-specific drug position; do not import obsolete CIMA shock algorithms wholesale.

uploaded_protocol_findings: The PNT now proposes concrete recipes for all17. These are candidates for the standard, not independent proof of product/container/microbial validation.
Noradrenaline100micrograms BASE/mL, fentanyl50micrograms/mL and propofol20mg/mL differ from old40/80,10 and10mg/mL examples: pump rates must be recalculated, never copied.
The24h-for-everything-except-propofol statement is not supported for the exact17 product/preparation systems. Immediate-use and physical/chemical data must stay distinct.
Do not universalize propofol6h just for transfer; Lipuro6h dilution/12h undiluted limits were checked. A locally stricter limit can be proposed but is not a universal manufacturer requirement.
Peripheral32micrograms/mL/18G and concentration-specific Y-site claims are proposed institutional rules, not verified generic manufacturer thresholds.
Signature and entry-into-force fields are blank. Earlier owner-declared names/date remain recorded separately, not inserted into a signed approval of this corrected PNT.

Latest owner instruction selects local Empressin1IU/mL and a distinct table. CIMA0.8IU/mL is retained as reference only; mandatory local24h ceiling is not manufacturer chemical certification. Lipuro6h diluted/12h undiluted immediate-use conditions now explicit.
